info.title: API.SH: Sreality
info.description: The Sreality API from API.SH: public Sreality data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
The listings of one Sreality agency (newest first by default) and the agency's details: name, logo, website, company number, rating, review count, address and directory link. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sreality-agency

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agency id (agency.id in /sreality/v1/listing, or the number at the end of a sreality.cz/adresar/... link).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

results.title: Prodej rodinného domu 272 m², pozemek 217 m²

get.description:
One Sreality listing: title, description, code, type, category, layout, price (CZK) with unit, per m², note and previous price, areas, floor, building type and condition, ownership, furnishing, energy rating, dates, views, location with coordinates, all photos with sizes, videos and 3D tour, every listed parameter, nearby places (shops, schools, transport, doctors...) with distance, and the agency (name, logo, website, company number, rating, address) with its broker. A private seller's own contact details are left out. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sreality-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number at the end of a sreality.cz/detail/... link). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location, category), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Czech places matching a name (municipalities, city parts, districts, regions, streets) with their type, id, region, district and coordinates.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sreality-places

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Property in the Czech Republic on Sreality with the site's filters: sale, rent, auction or shares; flats, houses, land, commercial or other; place with radius; price, area, land area, price per m², floor; layout, building type and condition, ownership, furnishing, energy rating; balcony, terrace, cellar, garage, lift, garden and other features; keywords; listing age and sort. Each result has id, link, title, type, category, layout, price (CZK) with unit and per m², location with coordinates, photos with room type, agency id and distances to nearby amenities. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sreality-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Czech place (city, district, region, street); the best match is used.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius around the place in km.

parameters.name: category_sub_cb
parameters.description: Layout or subtype codes, comma-separated (flats: 2=1+kk, 3=1+1, 4=2+kk, 5=2+1, 6=3+kk, 7=3+1, 8=4+kk, 9=4+1, 10=5+kk, 11=5+1, 12=6 and more, 16=atypical, 47=room).

parameters.name: building_type
parameters.description: Building type codes, comma-separated (1 wooden, 2 brick, 3 stone, 4 prefab, 5 panel, 6 skeleton, 7 mixed, 8 modular).

parameters.name: building_condition
parameters.description: Condition codes, comma-separated (1 very good, 2 good, 3 poor, 4 under construction, 5 project, 6 new build, 7 for demolition, 8 before renovation, 9 after renovation, 10 under renovation).

parameters.name: ownership
parameters.description: Ownership codes, comma-separated (1 personal, 2 cooperative, 3 state/municipal).

parameters.name: furnished
parameters.description: Furnishing codes, comma-separated (1 yes, 2 no, 3 partly).

parameters.name: energy_efficiency_rating_cb
parameters.description: Energy rating codes, comma-separated (1 A ... 7 G).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
